# Elevify

> > Elevify is a global online learning platform offering 25,000+ free courses with certificates and lifetime access, serving 250,000+ students across 100+ countries.

Founded by Rangel Barbosa, Elevify democratizes education through self-paced courses in diverse fields including health, business, technology, and vocational training. The platform features AI grading, offline access, and partnerships with organizations like IBM and Cogna.

## Key Topics

- Free online courses
- Self-paced learning
- Certificate programs
- Lifetime access
- Professional development
- Rangel Barbosa (Founder)
- Course marketplace
- Vocational training
- Health & medicine education
- Business & economics courses
- ACLS/BLS/ATLS certification
- Multilingual platform
- EdTech
- AI grading
- Offline learning
